purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0062 in the spin arena: the fear beat read in each token's own frame, U' = T (SWAP U) T^dagger with T the displacements to the two tokens' own points: gauge covariant with no phase, equal to the model's beat wherever the points coincide, and on live links it keeps the role's fermion number at every meeting while still making and spending fear, so an exactly conserved fermion number costs one choice, a meeting read in the tokens' own frames.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
